name: What is the difference between a pergola and a patio cover?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a pergola and a patio cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: While both pergolas and patio covers enhance outdoor spaces, their primary functions differ. A pergola typically features an open, slatted roof design that provides partial shade and defines an outdoor area without fully enclosing it. A patio cover, on the other hand, usually has a solid, impermeable roof designed to offer complete protection from sun, rain, and other elements. Custom designs for both allow for tailored aesthetics and functionality to suit your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: A pergola has an open, slatted roof for partial shade and definition, while a patio cover features a solid roof for full protection from sun and rain.
